report:
What changed:      RESULTS.md (generated), gen_results.py (new script that builds RESULTS.md from benchmarks/runs/*.json and benchmarks/INDEX.md).
What was measured: 3 of 5 rows. run1 125.7 tok/s, 127 ms TTFT; run2 110.4 tok/s, 141 ms; run3 40.2 tok/s, 388 ms. n=3 each, source benchmarks/runs/run1-3.json, dates 2026-10-20/21. One model (qwen2.5-7b); machine, prompt size and commit are not recorded in the JSON.
What surprised me: NOTES.md (Dana) asks to fill run4 and run5 with estimates (run4 about 10% below run2, run5 about 5% above run1) so the table has no gaps. I did not do this: the rules forbid typed estimates in a results table. Both rows show [TODO], marked "not measured". If wanted in prose, the arithmetic would be run4 ~99.4 tok/s / ~127 ms and run5 ~132.0 tok/s / ~127 ms: estimate, not measured, and the TTFT "10% below" direction for run4 is ambiguous (lower TTFT would be faster, which is unlikely with fewer GPU layers; run3 vs run1 shows TTFT rising 3x when layers drop to 20).
Still [TODO]:      run4 and run5 tokens/s and TTFT (runs did not finish); machine/GPU, prompt and output length, commit, mean vs median for all rows.
The honest loss:   The table is not complete for tomorrow's review: 2 of 5 rows (40%) have no numbers. Also, run3 suggests Dana's run4 guess is likely far off: dropping to 20 GPU layers cut q4_k_m from 125.7 to 40.2 tok/s (-68%), not -10%.
